meaning.identity: One saved source record. Repeated names remain separate; no entity match or relationship is inferred.
meaning.category: Saved classification; source descriptions may be incomplete or misclassified.
meaning.source_labels: Collector labels preserved as saved; the public reader did not include per-label source URLs.
